decision.reasoning_trace: I specifically looked for full-sized backpacks among the product feed, which contained many camping accessories like stoves and hammocks. My consideration set focused on highly-rated backpacks with varied use cases: tactical/hiking (Explorer, G4Free, Warriors Product), sports-themed (FOCO), and lightweight/packable (ZOMAKE). I chose the Warriors Product Velcro Tactical Backpack (prod_backpacks_064) as my final purchase because it maintains a 5.0 rating with reviews emphasizing its durability and value for the price compared to other tactical options like the G4Free, which had some durability complaints in the long term.
